# RoomXDynamics

> RoomXDynamics is a qualitative simulation of room air and walls for iPhone, available free on the App Store. It shows a section through a room with an outside wall and a window: how warm and cool air move in the model and how cool the wall surface gets. The results are trends in the model, not values for a real room. It is not a measurement and not an expert report.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone (iOS). App languages: German and English, following the language of the iPhone. Status: on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/roomxdynamics/id6832349433). Price: free.
- Audience: people who furnish, renovate or design their home.
- Air in the room: a two-dimensional flow simulation, shown qualitatively.
- Wall surface: heat conduction in a settled state with common design values; a qualitative risk estimate in three levels, with a range, for the open area of the outside wall and, in one line, for the outside edge. A real room corner is usually colder than the edge shown. It does not say whether mold will grow on a real wall, or why.
- The results have not been checked against real rooms.
- The website has no cookies, no analytics and no tracking.
